modules.description: Maintains business information and configuration settings.
Manages customer accounts, including adding/editing customer information, printing customer details, and handling related customer types (AccCustomer, NCustomer).
Manages due checks, with printing options for due check reports.
Manages invoices, including creation, editing, picking from other lists, and viewing invoices (with history).
Manages loading operations, likely for logistics, supporting add/edit, pick from, and printing of loading documents.
Manages post-dated cheques (PDC) with add/edit functionality.
Handles product catalog and categories, with add/edit forms for products and categories.
Provides daily, weekly, and monthly sales report printing options.
Manages salesman records, supporting add/edit operations.

Provides cross-cutting utilities including database access, encryption, global variables, SQL parsing, paging, and generic UI components such as splash screen, about box, search dialogs, date picker, bank and zip code selectors, and main application shell.
Handles stock receipt, monitoring, and viewing, with update capabilities and print options for stock in.
Manages supplier information with add/edit capabilities.
Handles user login and user record management (add/edit).
Oversees van operations including van inventory, collection, remittance, with add/edit forms and print options for each.
